text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Kikuka-sho, Sirius 
Symboli realized her own "obsession" with 
Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, his reasoning remained unchanged: 
the only reason he wouldn't face Sirius 
Symboli in a direct showdown was because 
she simply wasn't worth it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To prove that and take the "next" step 
forward, Sirius Symboli challenges the 
Kikuka Sho.
